name: secret-scanning
description: Secret-leak prevention: a PreToolUse hook that blocks a Write/Edit, or a Bash heredoc/echo written to a file, introducing a high-confidence secret (cloud keys, private-key blocks, provider tokens, assigned secret literals) before it reaches disk, plus a /secret-scanning:scan command to sweep a path or diff on demand. Fail-open, high-confidence-only, with a fixture escape and CC_SECRET_SCAN=off. A PostToolUse unicode-scan warns on invisible and bidi characters (zero-width, U+202A-E, tag block) in text just written or read.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_secret_scan.title: Secret guard (CC_SECRET_SCAN)
cc_secret_scan.description: Refuse a write or shell command that puts a high-confidence secret on disk: on or off. The environment variable CC_SECRET_SCAN overrides this.

cc_unicode_scan.title: Invisible-character scan (CC_UNICODE_SCAN)
cc_unicode_scan.description: Warn when written or read text carries zero-width or bidirectional-override characters: on or off. The environment variable CC_UNICODE_SCAN overrides this.
